blocks.text: BACOLOD CITY — The Alliance of Concerned Consumers in Electricity and Social Services (Access) has backed Senate President Sherwin Gatchalian’s call for the Department of Energy (DOE) and the Energy Regulatory Commission (ERC) to penalize power firms responsible for recurring and prolonged outages across the Visayas Grid. Access President Wennie Sancho said on Wednesday that Negros Occidental residents had suffered for months from unscheduled brownouts, voltage fluctuations, and unjust rate hikes while power firms routinely cited “forced outages” and “unplanned shutdowns” without accountability.
